name: zxing-cpp
description: The zxing-cpp package provides an open-source, multi-format 1D/2D barcode image processing library.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
      -D ZXING_C_API=OFF           \
      -D ZXING_EXAMPLES=OFF        \
      -D ZXING_WRITERS=BOTH        \
      -W no-dev .
